discovery.title: The Discovery
discovery.question: 🌍 The Question
discovery.questionText: In Rio de Janeiro, on October 16, 2025, a simple question arose: "When I have an idea here and now, where and when does it exist?"
discovery.mathText: This philosophical question led to a complete mathematical framework: knowledge as a dynamic field in space-time, governed by differential equations.
discovery.validationText: Tested with real data from COVID-19, Deep Learning, Bitcoin and Climate Change. Correlation >80% between predictions and observations.

simulation.title: Epistemic Topology Simulation
simulation.description: Interactively explore how ideas and knowledge propagate through space-time by adjusting diffusion, creation, and dissipation parameters.
simulation.colorsDesc: Represent knowledge density in each region of space-time.
simulation.diffusionDesc: Speed at which knowledge spreads spatially (sharing, communication, teaching).
simulation.creationDesc: Rate of new knowledge emergence (research, innovation, discovery).
simulation.dissipationDesc: Rate of knowledge loss (forgetting, death, record degradation).
simulation.totalDesc: Integral of all epistemic density - "total amount of knowledge" in the system.
simulation.entropyDesc: Measure of dispersion/uniformity. High entropy = knowledge uniformly distributed. Low = concentrated in few points.
simulation.exp4: Balance all to see dynamic equilibrium

analysis.title: Empirical Analysis: Knowledge Diffusion
analysis.subtitle: Model validation with real idea propagation data
analysis.blueLineDesc: Based on observable metrics (Google Trends, scientific papers, media mentions).
analysis.greenLineDesc: Prediction using our equation ∂ρ/∂t = D·∇²ρ + σ - μ·ρ with calibrated parameters.
analysis.correlationExcellent: Excellent fit - model captures real dynamics
analysis.googleTrendsDesc: Search volume reflects direct public interest. Proxy for ρ(popularity).
analysis.papersDesc: Academic publications indicate epistemic depth. Proxy for σ(creation).
analysis.mediaDesc: Media coverage amplifies diffusion. Proxy for D(dissemination).
analysis.diffusionHigh: High values (0.7-0.9) better for viral events. Low values (0.2-0.4) for specialized technical knowledge.
analysis.creationInsight: Crucial for predicting scientific revolutions. Underestimating causes conservative predictions.
analysis.dissipationInsight: Affects long-term stability. Passing fads have high μ (~0.03-0.05).
